name: 面部皮肤光滑度分析
description: Analyzes excessive skin smoothness from AI generation
algorithm: Face Skin Smoothness — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial skin smoothness for video deepfake detection:

1. **皮肤区域Segmentation**: Facial skin regions are segmented per frame, separating skin from eyes, eyebrows, lips, and hair. The skin regions — forehead, cheeks, nose, chin — are analyzed independently for texture quality.

2. **纹理频率分析**: High-frequency skin texture content is measured using local power spectral density. Natural skin contains multi-scale texture: pores (~0.5-1mm spacing), fine wrinkles, and skin grain. The method quantifies texture energy at these characteristic spatial frequencies. AI-generated skin often shows suppressed high-frequency texture — the over-smoothing artifact common in GAN-generated faces.

3. **Smoothness梯度检测**: The method maps smoothness variation across the face. Natural faces show region-dependent smoothness: smoother on cheeks, more textured on the nose and forehead. Deepfake faces may show unnaturally uniform smoothness or incorrect smoothness distribution across facial regions.

4. **皮肤DetailPreservation评估**: Fine skin details (individual pores, hair follicles, micro-wrinkles) are evaluated for rendering quality. These details help assess whether the skin texture is photographed (with characteristic sensor-captured detail) versus rendered (often lacking sub-pixel detail or showing repetitive synthetic patterns).

5. **时间皮肤纹理稳定性**: Natural skin texture is static — pores and micro-features remain in fixed positions frame-to-frame. The method tracks skin texture consistency over time. Deepfake generators may produce temporally varying skin texture where pore patterns shift, appear, or disappear between frames, creating detectable temporal texture instability.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through face skin smoothness analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
